_README: Spend/rate limits for agent calls (P3). Loaded by src/agents/limits.js, enforced by src/agents/spendGuard.js BEFORE every model call. Lot 1 defaults are deliberately closed: only the free mock model has a price, the daily cap is 0 USD and mode 'real' is refused, so no real call can happen. Change only via a reviewed PR.

_PRODUCT_OWNER_SETS_IN_LOT3.mode: 'real' (only after the Lot 3 approval; the loader refuses it until the code allows it)
_PRODUCT_OWNER_SETS_IN_LOT3.daily_spend_cap_usd: your hard daily ceiling across both providers, e.g. 2.00
_PRODUCT_OWNER_SETS_IN_LOT3.per_call_max_usd: ceiling for a single call, e.g. 0.25
_PRODUCT_OWNER_SETS_IN_LOT3.pricing_usd_per_mtok: add one entry per real model actually used, e.g. "openai/<model>" and "anthropic/<model>", with the provider's current list prices; a model without an entry is refused
